note: D-523. Block 06.04 is answered (D-545: poppler may be installed), but the app run's harness refused brew install, so this Mac still has no PDF renderer and a scan page cannot be looked at. The files are in the ignored library, 01-INTAKE/model/library/docs/fsm-1985-sections/. Also from Section 1 (P04): the tension bolt loosening and tightening sequences (p.1-27, 1-47), the four rotor apex positions (p.1-43), the drive plate position (p.1-49), the sealing rubber seam position (p.1-44), the four housing width points (p.1-34), the compression correction graphs (p.1-12) and the garbled fourth connector of PR-025.24 (p.1-19). Also from Section 4A (P07): the control unit's terminal table and connector face (p.4A-44; not taken at all - the OCR text lost the terminal letters and which voltage belongs to which), the carburettor table (p.4A-16, SP-1597) and the choke switch terminal pair (p.4A-32, SP-1593), both rebuilt from scrambled text; the G1 and G2 chambers (p.4A-60, SP-1603); the evaporative test's pass band (p.4A-45, PR-065.03); the temperature gauge range at which the choke releases (p.4A-64, PR-079.03); the fuel pump cut relay jumper (p.4A-47, PR-068.04); the brown and green checking connectors (p.4A-9, 4A-37); the carburettor strip items 1 to 12 (p.4A-56, PR-076.07); the automatic's lever positions in PR-064.05 (p.4A-41); the vacuum hose routing and system diagrams (p.4A-2 to 4A-4, 4A-15). Also from Section 5 (P08): the two outcomes of charging test 4 and the F terminal chart (p.5-7, 5-8, PR-082.05, SP-1614), the battery's specific gravity table (p.5-5), the advance graphs (p.5-36), the charging and starting circuit diagrams (p.5-6, 5-19), the alternator's bolts and brush wire hole (p.5-11, 5-18), the igniter test circuit (p.5-37) and the starter lever's direction (p.5-29). Also from Section 7B (P09), all other-car: the speedometer gear ratio (p.7B-2, SP-1626), the operation table (p.7B-8), the inhibitor switch's coupler terminal table (p.7B-17), the line pressure sign table's rows (p.7B-23, SP-1638 to SP-1640), the shift speed table and the shift pattern graph (p.7B-25, SP-1646), the oil pump assembling tool's number (p.7B-40, SP-1653), the valve body spring chart (p.7B-61, SP-1664), the valve body bolt positions (p.7B-65, SP-1665), the OD band's back-off turns (p.7B-77, SP-1667) and the second band of the diaphragm rod table (p.7B-78, SP-1669). Also from Section 9 (P11): the pinion spacer mark and thickness table (p.9-19, SP-1682), the differential carrier hanger's number (p.9-13, SP-1677), where the locking agent goes on the ring gear (p.9-21, PR-103.07), the tooth contact patterns (p.9-25, PR-105.03), the spacer's fitting direction and the two torques of the exploded view (p.9-12), and the hub, axle shaft and carrier figures the removal steps point at (p.9-5, 9-7, 9-11). Also from Section 10A (P12): the mounting block position table and its figure (p.10A-14, SP-1692), the direction a tie-rod is turned to lengthen it (p.10A-13, PR-115.10) and the specification table's layout (p.10A-3). Also from Section 11 (P13): where the caliper seal kit's orange and red greases go (p.11-7, PR-118.12), the directions of the master cylinder's cups and its check valve (p.11-18, PR-123.10), the tester's connections (p.11-19, PR-124.04), the push rod adjust gauge's number (p.11-24, SP-1696), and holes A and B and the arrow of the backing plate (p.11-11, PR-122.04). Also from Section 13 (P14): the knuckle arm and ball joint torque, whose N-m and ft-lb figures disagree in the text (p.13-8, 13-10, SP-1705), the triangle mark of the mounting block (p.13-5), and the stabilizer, tension rod and rear shock absorber nut setting figures (p.13-10, 13-12, 13-13, 13-17). Also from Section 14 (P15): the body checking dimensions (p.14-24; only SP-1281 is held, the rest is scrambled in the text - the body shop manual S-047, P31, overlaps), the windshield and side window dam, primer and spacer positions (p.14-21, 14-23, PR-153.08, PR-154.06), the top ceiling's flange and inserting point figures (p.14-13, 14-14, PR-148.08), the power window regulator's position before its motor is fitted (p.14-9, PR-145.08) and the hatch switch's contact points (p.14-12). Also from Section 15 (P16): the continuity tables the OCR text scrambled - the combination switch's light, turn and hazard, and wiper and washer tables (p.15-15), the left and right cluster switches (p.15-16), the power window switch (p.15-37, PR-172.03), the rear wiper switch (p.15-46, PR-177.03) and the blower switch (p.15-85, PR-182.01); the coolant level unit's test bulb wattage (p.15-25, PR-161.05); the choke and check relay's test wiring (p.15-26, PR-164.03); and the fusible link sizes and fuse ratings of the 1985 block (p.15-13; S-001 holds this car's).
